inputs.label: Silent Scope (USA) Dreamcast disc
inputs.help: The four files of your own Silent Scope disc, Dreamcast USA version V1.000: the .cue and its three Track .bin files, unzipped. The arcade ROM set and Silent Scope 2 do not work.

steps.text: Open Silent Scope - VR4ALL from Library > Unknown Sources. Choose Choose disc files and select the .cue and all three .bin files in Download together. The app copies and checks them; afterwards you can delete them from Download.

notes: Quest 3 and 3S; experimental. The app imports the disc through its own file picker and keeps a working copy, so the files take space twice until the user deletes the ones in Download; freeSpaceMB counts both. The release also holds silent-scope-vr-source.zip and SHA256SUMS.txt; the asset pattern takes only the APK. The guide gives no disc hashes.
